translated_title: Visits and Surgeries at Mexico's Public Hospitals Are Up as Much as 60% in Two Years
original_title: Consultas y cirugías en IMSS, Issste e IMSS Bienestar han aumentado hasta 60% en los últimos dos años
author: Néstor Jiménez and Arturo Sánchez
meta_description: Officials credit a shift from private care to the public system: 32 new hospitals and the 2023 IMSS Bienestar network now serving 56 million across 24 states.
